verdict.rationale: Opting out of model training is a fair privacy question for an AI video and image generation platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers training-data use, opt-out controls, or a data usage policy. The cited items are about generation features, pricing, plans and the API, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
